revision: S6/P6: schematic S6 (RANGE pot per channel); placement P6, 8HP (user direction 2026-11-14: per channel IN and CV jacks on the row, OUT jack under CV, RANGE knob under IN, VOL knob alone in the right column so no cable hangs over it; MIX jack under the last RANGE knob; vactrol on B in the right column, its LDR lead pair tucked under the VOL pot; power header along the bottom edge)
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Four rail holes as the modules/blank 8HP panel: X12.58 (Doepfer X7.5 moved 1HP right, as modules/midi) and X32.9 (4HP = 20.32 mm further). Skiff rails clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 39.3 x 110.0 mm, 0.5 mm inside the 40.3 mm panel each side and 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end; held by the ten jack nuts (the R0904N pots are snap-in, no nut). 4 layers as modules/acid / hats / ladder: F signal / In1 GND / In2 +12V / B signal (planes drawn with the routing). All assembled SMD on B. 1 mm board-edge keep-out (copper-edge rule 1.0 mm in the .kicad_pro).

jack_rotation_note: Unrotated: T pad toward the top (Y-4.92), TN (Y+3.38), S (Y+6.48).
channel_row_note: Each channel is one 31 mm cell from its jack row Y0: IN (X8.0, Y0) and CV (X20.15, Y0) jacks, OUT jack under CV (X20.15, Y0+15.0), RANGE under IN (shaft X8.0, Y0+14.5) and VOL alone in the right column (shaft X32.3, Y0+7.5): no jack sits above a VOL knob, so a patched cable never hangs over it. F courtyards: jack (-6.3..+7.85) to the jack or pot below 0.86 / 1.5 mm, centre-column jacks to the VOL pot 0.9 mm in X. MIX jack in the left column, 16.5 mm below the RANGE3 shaft.
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k linear, vertical snap-in, tall shaft (L = 25 mm, knurled, no threaded bushing, no nut): the pot Bread Modular uses, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint

pot_model.source: Song Huei R0904N(F) drawing R09N-003 v1.5 (2018-12-21) and shaft-type sheet, song-huei.com/proimages/PDF/R0904N.pdf
pot_model.note: L is measured from the PCB seat to the shaft tip. L = 25 is the tall trimmer (17 mm shaft as sold by Thonk/Exploding Shed; ~16 mm above the collar per the user). Fit envelope only: the body is a 9.7 x 11.4 x 7.6 mm box (11.4 = across the bracket legs) centred on the shaft and the shaft a cylinder, enough for panel Z clearance. Datasheet vs the BM footprint: bracket legs 10.6 mm apart (footprint slots 9.6) and pin row 7.0 mm from the shaft (footprint 7.5); the footprint is kept as Bread Modular has it (docs/research.md D3).

vactrol_part: Chinese VTL5C-type vactrol, Bread Modular VTL5C footprint unchanged (10.16 x 15.24 mm silk body). Mounted on B, upright in the right column below its VOL pot: the LDR lead pair sits between the pot bracket row and pin row (under the pot body on F), the body covers the three pot pins on B and the LED lead pair is clear of everything. Solder the vactrol before the VOL pot and trim its two upper leads flush on F.

vactrols.note: below RV1 (VOL1): lead pairs at X32.03 / 34.57, LDR pair Y29.75 (0.45 mm above the pot pin pads), LED pair Y42.45; courtyard X27.875..38.725, Y28.135..44.065. The 5 pth_inside_courtyard stacking items against RV1 are user-approved DRC exclusions (2026-11-14, tools/d10_exclusions.py).

below RV2 (VOL2): lead pairs at X32.03 / 34.57, LDR pair Y60.75 (0.45 mm above the pot pin pads), LED pair Y73.45; courtyard X27.875..38.725, Y59.135..75.065. The 5 pth_inside_courtyard stacking items against RV2 are user-approved DRC exclusions (2026-11-14, tools/d10_exclusions.py).

below RV3 (VOL3): lead pairs at X32.03 / 34.57, LDR pair Y91.75 (0.45 mm above the pot pin pads), LED pair Y104.45; courtyard X27.875..38.725, Y90.135..106.065. The 5 pth_inside_courtyard stacking items against RV3 are user-approved DRC exclusions (2026-11-14, tools/d10_exclusions.py).

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.source: PJ301M-12.step slices (MIDI module); the AudioJacks library marks the model Untested.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: R0904N L=25: body + collar top Z7.6 (2.4 mm under the panel rear), Ø6.0 shaft through the Ø7.2 hole (0.6 mm radial clearance), tip Z25.0, knurl Z18.0..25.0, fully above both panel fronts. No nut: the pots do not hold the panel. Checked as an envelope in docs/fit/fit-report.json.
stack_Z_mm.vactrol_note: Vactrols are on B (body behind the board), so they add depth behind the board and never reach the panel; no 3D model (docs/research.md D4).

power_header.orientation: Horizontal along the bottom edge, as modules/hats (rot 270 on B): odd pins on the upper row Y113.4, even pins on Y115.94; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the left, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the right. Courtyard Y111.59..117.77 (1 mm edge keep-out: board edge Y119.25). Moved right of the MIX jack for P6.
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the left); positions 11-16 overhang to the right, over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. No THT pad under it (MIX jack pads end at X9.55); SMD under the overhang must stay under 2.5 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: bottom edge, horizontal, as modules/hats power_header (rot 270 on B)

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer).

panel_label_note: Jack labels 6.5 mm above the jack centre. Knob labels clear the widest printed knob (mechanical/knobs `wide/`, 16 mm): RANGE 8.3 mm above the shaft (0.3 mm outside a 16 mm knob, 1.0 mm below the IN jack nut corners), VOL 9.0 mm above the shaft.
